verdict.rationale: Scheduled or recurring searches, such as saved-search alerts, are a plausible capability for an AI research engine, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows a REST API and MCP server that a developer could call from their own scheduler to run automated searches. That is a developer building block for one-off calls, not a first-party recurring schedule, and nothing documents scheduled jobs, alerts or recurring workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
